headline: UnitedHealth Analysts Increase Their Forecasts After Better-Than-Expected Q2 Results
summary: UnitedHealth Group Inc. (NYSE:UNH) reported strong Q2 results, beating earnings estimates and raising guidance. Analysts expect continued growth.
